method: Open Pretest bugs at 00:00 Asia/Taipei on each Monday, over the ticket list as it stood on computed_at: both Round2 workbooks BugList keys plus filter 12399 Bugs whose title has PCTS or Facet, 148 keys. CP and AA together, a ticket on both sides counted once. Counted in Jira with `status WAS NOT IN (Done, "Non-issue", "Ready for test", "Eng build", "Monitoring", "Ready for integration") ON <Monday 00:00> AND created < <Monday 00:00>`, then corrected on 2026-11-13 by adding back the tickets that query had excluded for sitting in Ready for integration, which now counts as open (see revised_2026_11_13). The daily pretest snapshots in history.json take over from here.
split_method: Same instants and same 148-key scope as open_at, split by the status each ticket was in at that moment: red = `status WAS IN (Blocked, "To Do", Reopen) ON <Monday 00:00>`, yellow = `status WAS IN ("In Progress", "Ready for integration") ON <Monday 00:00>`, both with `AND created < <Monday 00:00>`. "other" is open_at minus those two — tickets in an open status that is neither (Need info / Ready for review); it is not queried, it is the residual, and it is non-zero in only three weeks. Run as 32 queries by hand plus 16 for Ready for integration; every weekly red + yellow + other was checked against open_at before it was written here.
revised_2026_11_13: Ready for integration stopped counting as done (build_data.py) and became part of yellow (gen_dashboard.py). Both open_at and open_by_bucket.yellow were raised by the number of tickets in that status at each instant: 2026-08-10 +1, 2026-09-07 +2, 2026-09-14 +1, 2026-09-21 +2, 2026-10-26 +4, 2026-11-02 +10, 2026-11-09 +8; every other week was zero. red and other are untouched. The figures before this revision are in git history if the old definition is ever needed.
